KPlugin.Name: Talk2PC Bridge
KPlugin.Description: Streams the real cursor position to the Talk2PC desktop app (com.lycheenow.talk2pcdesktop.KWinBridge) so phone-driven input overlays follow the pointer. Runs passively; no window or file access.
KPlugin.Description[zh_CN]: 把真实光标位置流式推送给 Talk2PC 桌面应用（com.lycheenow.talk2pcdesktop.KWinBridge），让手机驱动的输入悬浮窗跟随指针。被动运行，不访问窗口内容或文件。
